rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose term for the area of a piece of land, with the acre unit supplied by context.

example.english: How large is the acreage of this plot of land?
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 dei6 ge3 min6 zik1 jau5 gei2 daai2

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean the number of acres making up the land area.

example.english: The document must state the acreage of this plot of land.
example.traditional: 份文件要列明呢幅地嘅英畝數。
example.jyutping: fan6 man4 gin6 jiu3 lit6 ming4 ne1 fuk1 dei6 ge3 jing1 mau5 sou3
